section-cta.heading: Ready for performance management that actually drives results?

items.question: What does performance management consulting include?
items.answer: It covers your performance management framework and strategy, goal setting and alignment, continuous feedback and check-ins, the review cycle and calibration, manager coaching, development plans and the governance and metrics that keep the system live, as part of your wider talent management, all aligned to your business goals.

items.question: Do you replace annual performance reviews?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We design the cycle that fits you, whether that is a lighter annual review backed by continuous check-ins or a fully continuous model, so the performance management process drives results instead of creating paperwork.

items.question: How long does a performance management engagement take?
items.answer: Designing the framework, goals and review cycle takes a few weeks; embedding it is an ongoing effort, because performance management is a running system reviewed on a rhythm, not a one-off rollout.

items.question: Do you enable our managers, not just design the process?
items.answer: Yes. Equipping managers to set goals, give feedback and hold fair performance conversations is the core of the engagement, so the system works in practice, not just on paper.

items.question: What do we get at the end?
items.answer: A performance framework, aligned goals, a review and calibration cycle, manager enablement and the performance metrics you own and run.
